work.h2a: What we actually do inside the

steps.t: Choose packages and put your name on them.
steps.d: Each package has a written scope and a slot for your own service name, so you sell it the way you describe it.

steps.t: Take every client through one intake.
steps.d: A single intake form per client, with a client code, keeps onboarding the same however many you sell.

steps.t: Follow delivery against the written scope.
steps.d: A tracker shows each client's stage against the scope, so you can answer a client without asking us first.

steps.t: Set your price and see your margin.
steps.d: You choose the client price. The gap between that and our wholesale rate is yours, and you can see it per package.
